Title: Standard Login with Registered Email - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a registered email address in the email field | Enter the correct password in the password field | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: User is authenticated, redirected to the Home feed, a secure session is created, and the user’s profile name and avatar appear in the header.

Title: Standard Login with Registered Phone Number - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a registered phone number in the phone field | Enter the correct password | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: User is authenticated, redirected to the Home feed, and a persistent login session is created.

Title: Login with Valid Email but Incorrect Password - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a registered email address | Enter an incorrect password | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: Authentication fails, user remains on the login page, and the error message "Incorrect password" is displayed. The failed attempt is logged.

Title: Login with Unregistered Email - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter an email address that is not linked to any account | Enter any password | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: Authentication fails, and the message "No account found with this email/phone" is shown with options to sign up or recover account.

Title: Login with Unregistered Phone Number - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a phone number that is not linked to any account | Enter any password | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: Authentication fails, and the message "No account found with this email/phone" is displayed.

Title: Empty Credential Submission - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Leave email/phone and password fields blank | Click the "Log In" button
Expected Result: Client‑side validation prevents the request, inline validation messages appear for required fields, and no request is sent to the backend.

Title: Password Visibility Toggle - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter any password | Click the "Show" password icon | Verify password characters become visible | Click the "Hide" password icon | Verify password characters are masked again
Expected Result: Password visibility toggles correctly; default state is masked. The toggle is operable via mouse, keyboard, and is announced by screen readers.

Title: Remember Me Session Persistence - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter valid credentials | Check the "Remember Me" option | Click "Log In" | Close the browser completely | Reopen the browser and navigate to http://facebook.com
Expected Result: User is automatically logged in without re‑entering credentials; session persists across browser restarts until logout or expiration.

Title: Login with Two‑Factor Authentication (Valid OTP) - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a registered email and correct password for an account with 2FA enabled | Click "Log In" | Enter the valid OTP received via SMS/email/authenticator app | Click "Verify"
Expected Result: OTP is accepted, user is authenticated, redirected to Home feed, and a secure session is created.

Title: Login with Expired OTP - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter valid credentials for a 2FA‑enabled account | Click "Log In" | Wait until the OTP expires | Enter the expired OTP | Click "Verify"
Expected Result: Authentication fails, error message "Invalid or expired code" is displayed, and the user can request a new OTP.

Title: Login with Incorrect OTP - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter valid credentials for a 2FA‑enabled account | Click "Log In" | Enter an incorrect OTP | Click "Verify"
Expected Result: Authentication fails, error message "Invalid or expired code" appears, and the user may request a new OTP.

Title: Account Locked after Multiple Failed Attempts - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a valid email | Enter an incorrect password | Click "Log In" | Repeat the above step until the allowed failed‑attempt threshold is exceeded
Expected Result: Account is temporarily locked, message "Account temporarily locked" is shown, and the user is directed to password reset or identity verification flow.

Title: Forgot Password Flow - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Click the "Forgot password?" link | Enter a registered email or phone number | Submit the request | Enter the recovery code received | Set a new password | Confirm the new password | Submit and log in with the new credentials
Test Data: email: user@example.com, recovery code: 987654, new password: NewPass123!
Expected Result: Recovery code is accepted, password is updated, and the user can log in successfully with the new password.

Title: Login from New Device with Verification - Positive
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com from a device/location not previously recognized | Enter valid credentials | Click "Log In" | Complete the additional verification challenge (e.g., enter code sent to registered device) | Confirm verification
Expected Result: After successful verification, user is logged in, receives a login alert notification, and the new device is added to trusted devices list.

Title: Login from New Device without Completing Verification - Negative
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com from an unknown device | Enter valid credentials | Click "Log In" | Dismiss or fail the additional verification challenge
Expected Result: Login is blocked, error message indicating verification is required is displayed, and no session is created.

Title: Login Page Load Performance - Non-Functional
Steps: Measure page load time for http://facebook.com under normal network conditions | Repeat measurement during peak traffic using load testing tool with 10,000 concurrent users
Expected Result: Login page loads within 2 seconds under normal conditions and within 4 seconds under peak load; no HTTP errors are returned.

Title: Keyboard Navigation Accessibility - Non-Functional
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Use the Tab key to move focus through all interactive elements (email/phone field, password field, Show/Hide icon, Remember Me checkbox, Log In button, Forgot password link) | Press Enter to activate focused elements
Expected Result: All elements receive focus in a logical order, can be activated via keyboard, and visual focus indicator is visible.

Title: Screen Reader Compatibility - Non-Functional
Steps: Open http://facebook.com with a screen reader (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver) | Navigate through the login form | Listen to announcements for each field and error message
Expected Result: Screen reader correctly reads labels, placeholder text, error messages, and button names; no information is missing.

Title: Login with Maximum Length Email (255 characters) - Edge
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter an email address consisting of 255 characters before the @ symbol followed by a valid domain | Enter the correct password | Click "Log In"
Expected Result: If the email is registered, authentication succeeds and user is redirected; if not registered, appropriate "No account found" message appears. System handles the length without truncation errors.

Title: Login with Email Containing Allowed Special Characters - Edge
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter an email address containing allowed special characters (e.g., user+test@example.co.uk) | Enter the correct password | Click "Log In"
Expected Result: Authentication succeeds and user is redirected to Home feed; system accepts special characters per RFC 5322.

Title: Login with Phone Number Including Leading Zeros - Edge
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter a phone number that includes leading zeros (e.g., 00123456789) | Enter the correct password | Click "Log In"
Expected Result: Phone number is normalized and authentication succeeds if the account exists; otherwise, appropriate error is shown.

Title: Logout and Re‑Login Flow - Positive
Steps: Log in with valid credentials | Click the user avatar to open the dropdown menu | Select "Log Out" | Verify that the session is terminated and login page is displayed | Enter the same credentials again | Click "Log In"
Expected Result: Logout invalidates the session, user is returned to login page, and subsequent login succeeds with a new session.

Title: Session Persistence without Remember Me - Negative (Edge)
Steps: Navigate to http://facebook.com | Enter valid credentials without checking "Remember Me" | Click "Log In" | Close the browser completely | Reopen the browser and navigate to http://facebook.com
Expected Result: User is not automatically logged in; login page is shown, confirming that session does not persist across browser restarts when Remember Me is unchecked.

Title: Concurrent Login Attempts from Multiple Devices - Edge
Steps: From Device A, log in with valid credentials | From Device B, simultaneously attempt to log in with the same credentials | Observe session handling on both devices
Expected Result: Both devices receive valid sessions (or the platform enforces single active session policy as defined); no race condition or session corruption occurs.
